[2025-01-16] ED Pre-Arrival Notes: ED Pre-Arrival Notes Result date: January 16, 2025 13:05 UTC. Pre-Arrival Summary: 68F increased weakness, blood sugar 500s per EMS.

[2025-01-16] History & Physical: Admit H&P: 68F with severe community-acquired pneumonia, sepsis, acute hypoxic respiratory failure requiring O2. Hyperglycemia on arrival. Plan: IV ceftriaxone, azithro, IVF cautious, insulin, cultures, CXR/CT, labs, O2 titration.

[2025-01-17] Daily Progress Note: Hospital Day 2: Persistent fevers, tachycardia improved with antibiotics. O2 requirement 3L NC. Reviewed labs (WBC, lactate trend) and imaging. Continue IV ceftriaxone/azithro, monitor cultures, adjust insulin, DVT prophylaxis, PT/OT.

[2025-01-17] Medication Reconciliation Note: Med rec completed. Chronic meds reviewed and reconciled with inpatient orders.

[2025-01-18] Daily Progress Note: Hospital Day 3: Patient reports improved breathing. On 2L O2 via NC. Continues IV antibiotics and diuresis. Reviewed CXR, daily labs. PT assisted with ambulation 2 laps on unit. Continue current regimen; monitor for decompensation.

[2025-01-19] Daily Progress Note: Hospital Day 4: Afebrile. O2 1-2L with ambulation. Cultures negative to date. Reviewed labs; glucose better controlled. Transition planning started; continue IV antibiotics today, consider PO step-down tomorrow.

[2025-01-20] Daily Progress Note: Hospital Day 5: Continued improvement. Off O2 at rest; minimal O2 with exertion. Antibiotics adjusted to PO step-down. Reviewed imaging and labs; continued insulin titration. Discharge planning with case management.

[2025-01-21] Daily Progress Note: Hospital Day 6: Shortness of breath worsened overnight; O2 back to 2L. Re-reviewed imaging; ordered repeat CXR and additional labs. Restarted IV diuresis. High concern for complication or volume overload; close monitoring.

[2025-01-22] Daily Progress Note: Hospital Day 7: Improved after diuresis; O2 down to 1L. Reviewed repeat CXR and labs. Continue PO antibiotics, continue insulin adjustments. Anticipate discharge in 24-48 hours if stable.

[2025-01-23] Discharge Summary: Discharge Summary: Admit for severe CAP complicated by sepsis and acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Improved with IV antibiotics, O2, and diuresis. Discharge meds reviewed, follow-up arranged, return precautions provided. Total discharge management time > 30 minutes.
